event_handlers_audited.name: requestForge
protections: wrapped in try/catch with forgeError fallback
stale-selection check: if all selected heroes are gone from available, clears selection and shows forgeError
never sets state with undefined or invalid values

event_handlers_audited.name: confirmForge
protections: snapshot heroIdsSnapshot before any state mutation
refreshUser wrapped in inner try/catch (soft warn)
secondary apiCall wallet/soul-forge swallow errors via allSettled + catch

event_handlers_audited.name: toggle (hero select)
protections: alerts on high-rarity without override (no immediate state mutation)
no number operations on undefined heroes

event_handlers_audited.name: inline cancel onPress
protections: empty try/catch around setState pair so accidental setter exception cannot crash UI
